description: Fill in a test from a plain description, or work a change into an existing test, as the prompt field of the Test Lab's test form does. Nothing is saved: the fields come back in create_test's names, to check and then save with create_test, or with update_test for an existing test. Uses the project's system knowledge and categories. For many tests at once use generate_tests instead.

instruction.description: What the test should check, in plain words, or with test: the change to make to that test.
instruction.title: Instruction

mode.description: Keep the draft in this mode; left out, the test's mode, or any for a new test.
mode.title: Mode

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

test.description: A saved test to change instead of a new one.
test.title: Test

name: draft_test
